summary: Compared the careers shared-footer reference, rendered crop, diff, and retained geometry. The footer has a failing height delta and broad typography/alignment mismatches.
issues: VIS-SHARED-FOOTER-001 (high) — property: section geometry; expected: x=0, y=3188, width=1920, height=614; actual: x=0, y=3189, width=1920, height=636; fix: remove the extra 22 px of footer height and align its start after upstream shared spacing is corrected.

VIS-SHARED-FOOTER-002 (high) — property: typography; expected: mostly regular-weight body/link text with source heading emphasis; actual: menu, certification, legal, and copyright text render materially heavier/smaller with different metrics throughout; fix: match the per-role source font weights, sizes, and line-heights instead of applying a broadly bold style.

VIS-SHARED-FOOTER-003 (medium) — property: certification and decorative-mark layout; expected: certification label on two lines with badges and the outlined mark beginning near x=1677; actual: label wraps to three lines, badges shift, and the outlined mark is larger/right-shifted; fix: restore source column widths and exact SVG dimensions/placement.

VIS-SHARED-FOOTER-004 (medium) — property: copyright row spacing; expected: copyright and agency credit sit around y=583 within the 614 px footer; actual: both sit lower and use smaller text due to the taller component; fix: match the source footer bottom-row padding and baseline.
